senses.gloss:
mfn. (-जित्)
Who or what conquers or surpasses.
E.
जि to conquer, affix क्विप्.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Conquered, subdued, surpassed, overcome.
m. (-तः)
One of the attendants upon a Jina or Jaina saint.
E.
जि to conquer, aff. क्त.

m. (-शिः)
The fist doubled.
E.
जित conquered, काश to shine, इनि aff.

mfn. (-शी-शिनी-शि)
Victorious.
E.
जित conquered, and काशिन् who shines, from काशृ, with णिनि aff.

mfn. (-धः-धा-धं)
Of subdued passion, not to be provoked or made angry.
E.
जित, and क्रोध wrath.

m. (-मिः)
A staff made of the wood of the religious fig tree.
E.
जित excelled, (by which,) and नेमि circumference of a wheel, (of any other wood.)

mfn. (-त्रुः-त्रुः-त्रु)
Victorious, triumphant.
m. (-त्रुः)
The father of AJITA, the 2nd Jaina saint.
E.
जित, and शत्रु a foe: see other similar compounds, as जितामित्र, जितारि, &c.

m. (-मः)
One who is free from worldly cares, a stoic^1.
E.
जित, and श्रम fatigue, exertion.
[1] Correction submitted by Dr. Sampada Savardekar on 20210731. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/csl-corrections/issues/66.

mfn. (-रः-रा-रं)
Reading well or readily.
E.
जित mastered, and अक्षर a letter.

mfn. (-त्मा-त्मा-त्म)
Self-subdued, void of passion.
E.
जित, and आत्मन् spirit.

mfn. (-त्रः-त्रा-त्रं)
Triumphing, victorious over an enemy.
m. (-त्रः)
VIṢṆU.
E.
जित subdued, by whom, and अमित्र a foe.

mfn. (-रिः-रिः-रि)
Victorious, triumphant.
m. (-रिः)
1 A Jina or Jaina deified saint.
2 The father of SAMBHAVA, the third of the Jaina pontiffs of this age.
3 A conqueror.
E.
जित conquered, (by whom,) and अरि an enemy.

mfn. (-वः-वा-वं)
Victorious, triumphant.
E.
जित conquered, and आहव war, battle.

mfn. (-यः-या-यं)
Having subdued the senses, calm, unmoved.
m. (-यः)
An ascetic, a sage, one who has completely subdued his passions.
E.
जित subdued, इन्द्रिय an organ of sense.

n. (-त्वं)
Continence, subjugation of the senses or passions.
E.
त्व added to the last.

mfn. (-मः-मा-मं)
Most victorious, first of the victors.
m. (-मः)
The constellation, Gemini.
E.
जित, and तमप् aff.

mfn. (-त्यः-त्या-त्यं)
Conquerable, vincible.
m. (-त्यः)
A harrow.
f. (-त्या)
A ploughshare.
E.
जि to excel, क्यप् affix, तुक् augment.

mfn. (-रः-री-रं)
Victorious, triumphant.
f. (-री)
The city of Benares.
E.
जि to conquer or excel, क्वरप् affix, तुक् inserted, fem. affix ङीप्.

ind.
Having conquered or excelled.
E.
जि to conquer, क्त्वाच् aff.
